Class MagicianTalisman

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.github.thebusybiscuit.slimefun5.api.items.SlimefunItem

    public class MagicianTalisman
extends Talisman
    The MagicianTalisman is a special kind of Talisman which awards a Player with an extra Enchantment when they enchant their ItemStack.
